name: Crypto
tagline: A read-only coin watcher: prices, move alerts, unlock calendar, wallet lookups
description: Covers the useful side of following coins: a morning price summary, alerts when something significant moves, periodic digest roundups, and a calendar of upcoming token unlocks. Wallet checks are look-only, and everything is reported inside the chat. It never trades, holds funds, or asks for access to anything.
author: Robert1
